Summary of the extraction: the score lineage runs 59.29 → 60.01 (tournament fix) → 60.40 (specialist merges) → 60.41 (3-round recursive STM, all-time best) → 60.40 (sparse+FP4 tie) → 59.47 (shared-indexer restructure regression). Hard do-not-retry items: tied-embedding OEC (NaN twice), any post-SLERP continued training (three independent failures), full-model torch.compile on torch 2.10.0+cu128, deep-and-thin, hourglass FFN, and FP4 as a speed lever.
